beats.say: Emily McGonagle voices eight characters in Spike.
The Guardian says she was an Essex lawyer.
She quit her job to pursue acting.
Spike follows a young dragon and his friends.
The show launched on Netflix on 12 October.
She records in a wardrobe turned vocal booth.
Her husband Ciaran helped build the soundproofing.
She also voices 20 characters in Game of Thrones Kingsroad.
Could you voice eight characters at once?

facts: Emily McGonagle plays eight characters in an animated series called Spike.
The programme Spike launched on the streaming network on 12 October.
Emily McGonagle converts a large wardrobe into a soundproofed vocal booth with the support of her husband Ciarán.
Emily McGonagle provides the voices for 20 characters in the video game Game of Thrones Kingsroad.
